leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a binary search function that accepts a sorted array and a target value.
Initialize and manipulate pointers to track the search range within the array.
Construct a loop that repeatedly halves the search space until the target is found or the range is exhausted.
Apply conditional logic to compare the middle element with the target and adjust pointers accordingly.
Configure the function to return the index of the target if found, or a sentinel value like -1 if not present.
Integrate the binary search function into a simple test script to verify its correctness with sample data.
Control the search process by ensuring the loop terminates correctly for all possible inputs.
